entities.title: Passports and ID Cards
entities.summary: The page provides information on how to apply for a German passport or ID card in Pakistan.
required_documents: Civil status documents (especially birth and marriage certificates)
entities.processing_time: at least seven months for document verification, approximately seven to ten working days for ID document production
entities.application_fee: PKR 75,000 for verification of Pakistani documents, EUR 73.50 to EUR 128.00 for passport, EUR 70.60 to EUR 89.00 for ID card
entities.validity: 6 to 10 years for passport, 6 years for ID card
important_notes: A child may not have acquired German citizenship at birth if one parent was born after 01.01.2000.
Documents issued by Pakistani authorities must be verified by a cooperation lawyer.
